mission.weights: frozen M10 history-seed1 CVAE; old PPO seed0 shadow only

selection.development: Evaluate all 4 and four fixed controls on the same 32 conditions. Rank by total misses, consequence-weighted censored delay, travel, candidate id; retain first two. No test access.
selection.validation: Evaluate both retained candidates and four fixed controls on 32 validation conditions. Eligible only if every underlying seed has missed_delta<=0 vs tour, aggregate delay_delta<=0 and at least one strict miss or delay improvement. Among eligible use the same deterministic ranking. If none eligible select TOUR as revised fallback.
selection.test: Freeze selected config or TOUR before opening test outputs; evaluate five methods once on 64 conditions. No further selection, updates or seed replacement.

statistics.dependence: Noise/method/phase repetitions share physical seeds; give each underlying seed and fixture stratum; no independent-n claim for rollouts.
statistics.worst_seed_tolerance: 0 additional missed records for each validation/test physical seed; final breach prevents stable-superiority claim; delay tradeoff is disclosed, not hidden.

resource_caps.partition: 4gpu CPU allocation if cu remains full; otherwise cu

stop_rules: Any leakage/constraint breach stops advancement, preserve diagnostics.
Pilot count, full trajectory or cost mismatch is NO-GO until implementation repair and new versioned rerun; no scoring changes to chase old positives.
No extra model/candidate/seed search after validation or test.
Test worst-seed missed_delta>0 or nonpositive aggregate utility means no stable-superiority claim; preserve and stop scope expansion.
this_turn_execution_boundary: Run actual Torch tests, old regression and ten-case CPU pilot, then deliver GO/NO-GO for later formal submission. Do not open new final test during preflight.

review_corrections.candidate_prefilter: Keep potentially positive cues at current OR terminal bounded forecast, check positivity at actual completion, including cooling-down targets.
review_corrections.public_schema: Finite numeric inputs, closed nested schedule/topology schema and primary_supply_c telemetry.
review_corrections.near_tour_guard: For target TOUR ETA<=60, require target benefit > execution + unscaled first collateral + unscaled full future-risk cost; independent of the soft net weighting.
review_corrections.reason: Independent correctness review, not tuning to improve old scores.
